Gulper.io
What is Gulper.io?
Gameplay: A free, browser-based multiplayer arcade game where you control a glowing cyber worm in a dark neon arena, inspired by classic snake and Tron lightcycles.
Objective: Eat glowing energy pellets to grow longer and thicker, and trap rival worms to make them crash and drop their food.
Developer & Release: Created by developer tonsomar and released around December 2018 or January 2019.
Platforms: Available on web browsers (desktop and mobile) and iOS. You can also play it on platforms like CrazyGames and SilverGames. 
Controls & Mechanics
Desktop: Move your mouse to steer, and hold the Left Mouse Button or Spacebar to activate a speed boost.
Mobile / Touchscreen: Use sliding/swiping gestures or an on-screen joystick, holding a second finger to accelerate.
Speed Boost: Sprinting increases your speed, but it gradually decreases your length and score.
Rooms: Join public rooms or type "Nickname@RoomName" to jump into specific rooms.
